data.name: Greshika
data.long_meaning: Greshika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘grish’ which means ‘grain’ and ‘ikha’ which means ‘flowing’ or ‘moving’. The name is believed to represent the goddess of grains and wealth. In Hindu mythology, Greshika is also known as Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
